task.description:
WF-03 Step 03: Implement ISS-0073 fix per src/design/iss-0073-oidc-callback-realm.md on branch feature/WF03-oidc-callback-realm-20260616.

Changes needed (read the design and actual files first):

1. Add buildRedirectArgs() helper near the top of the affected file(s):
   function buildRedirectArgs(): { redirect_uri: string } | undefined {
     const slug = resolveRealmFromUrl()  // from tenantConfig.ts
     if (!slug) return undefined
     return { redirect_uri: window.location.origin + '/auth/callback?realm=' + encodeURIComponent(slug) }
   }

2. In ProtectedRoute.tsx: change m.signinRedirect() → m.signinRedirect(buildRedirectArgs())

3. In AuthProvider.tsx: change m.signinRedirect() → m.signinRedirect(buildRedirectArgs())

Import resolveRealmFromUrl from tenantConfig.ts where needed.

Validation:
  python tools/lint_frontend_conventions.py web/src (exits 0)
  cd web && npm run type-check (exits 0)
  cd web && npm run lint (exits 0)
  cd web && npm run build (exits 0)

Commit:
  git add -A
  git commit -m 'fix(WF03): embed realm in OIDC redirect_uri to survive Keycloak callback (ISS-0073)'
  git push origin feature/WF03-oidc-callback-realm-20260616

result.summary: ISS-0073 fix: added buildRedirectArgs() in ProtectedRoute.tsx and AuthProvider.tsx; both signinRedirect() call sites now embed realm slug in redirect_uri; all validations exit 0
